name: 4Lungs4ever
source:
A gardener who loves sweets,

A serious corporate employee,

A disheveled wanderer with a fat cat,

And a mysterious man who arrives with a movie ticket. 

You are an ordinary office worker simply looking for lunch, but fate leads you to encounter these four unique older men across different paths. 

In this heart-pounding dating sim featuring men nearing retirement, will you—the protagonist—be able to save the world... or even just your own life?

[Translated from [url=https://taiwen.itch.io/4lungs4ever]Itch.io[/url]]
